jokes.hikaru_nakamura: Hikaru Nakamura can calculate 30 moves ahead, yet every time he says, “I literally don’t care,” he misses the obvious reply: “Then why are you still talking?”
jokes.rfk_jr: RFK Jr.’s brain worm took one look at his ideas and said, “Sorry, I’m very careful about what I put in my body.”
jokes.sherlock_holmes: Sherlock Holmes can identify 140 types of tobacco ash, yet somehow can’t recognize the universal facial expression for “Please stop talking, you Victorian cokehead.”
jokes.demis_hassabis: Demis Hassabis built AlphaGo to defeat humanity at its most complex game—then joined Google and met the real final boss: shipping a product before it gets rebranded.
jokes.steph_curry: Steph Curry can connect from 40 feet, but after 15 seasons, his mustache and beard still can’t.
jokes.sam_altman: Sam Altman warns that AI may become impossible to shut down—his board tested the theory on him, and five days later he was CEO again.
jokes.lisa_manoban: Lisa has so many brand deals, BLACKPINK sounds less like a girl group and more like the group chat where her sponsors coordinate.
jokes.alex_honnold: Alex Honnold is so emotionally unavailable, he free-solos just to spend six hours with the only thing colder than him: a granite wall.
jokes.jon_stewart: Jon Stewart doesn’t tell punchlines—he just squints into the camera until liberals mistake hearing their own opinions for comedy.
jokes.dario_amodei: Dario Amodei left OpenAI over safety concerns and founded Anthropic—because nothing says “I fear unchecked power” like insisting it report directly to you.
jokes.pam_anderson: Pamela Anderson became famous running in slow motion on *Baywatch*—which is also how her career left Hollywood.
jokes.whitney_cummings: Whitney Cummings had a sex robot made in her own image—and somehow it has warmer delivery and fewer artificial parts.
jokes.donald_trump: Donald Trump is the human version of a pop-up ad: loud, misleading, impossible to close, and still asking for your credit-card number.
jokes.james_franco: James Franco has acted, directed, written novels, taught college, and hosted the Oscars—proof that if you fail in enough fields, people start calling you a Renaissance man.
jokes.jonah_hill: Jonah Hill has two Oscar nominations—one for standing next to Brad Pitt, one for standing next to Leonardo DiCaprio. He’s not a supporting actor; he’s Hollywood’s most decorated plus-one.
jokes.rob_lowe: Rob Lowe has aged like fine wine: smooth, expensive-looking, and only brought out when the good actors aren’t available.
jokes.nikki_glaser: Nikki Glaser built a career talking about sex in a voice that’s 99.9% effective at preventing it.
jokes.blake_griffin: Blake Griffin once jumped over a Kia—still the closest he ever came to driving anything to a championship.
jokes.caitlyn_jenner: Caitlyn Jenner won Olympic gold, joined the Kardashians, and ran for governor—apparently the decathlon wasn’t enough events in the Attention Olympics.
jokes.alec_baldwin: Alec Baldwin was perfect in *The Boss Baby*—finally, a role that matched both his emotional maturity and his preferred volume.
